claims.claim: Pikud Ha'Oref defines time-to-shelter bands of immediate, 15, 30, 45, 60 seconds, with 90 seconds (1.5 min) as the default for most of Israel.
claims.source: Pikud Ha'Oref public guidance via col.org.il / mako and oref.org.il (Pakar Q&A).

claims.claim: Tel Aviv and Jerusalem are in the 90-second band; Sderot is in the 15-second band.
claims.source: Pikud Ha'Oref zone mapping, summarized by RedAlert / ETA-IL / Masa Israel docs.

claims.claim: Northern border communities adjacent to Lebanon (Kiryat Shmona, Metula, Manara, Yiftach) have effectively zero warning time post-Iron-Swords; the pre-2024 '180 seconds' figure is no longer accurate.
claims.source: Pikud Ha'Oref post-Iron-Swords doctrine updates; mako coverage of guideline changes.

claims.claim: Pikud Ha'Oref publishes a multi-stage warning system for ballistic threats from Iran: ~15-min advance advisory, ~10-min improvement warning, ~90-sec siren+app alert, then explicit release message.
claims.source: Davar1 reporting on the new advance-warning + release-message protocol; mako and ynet coverage of the same.

claims.claim: For ballistic / Iran / Houthi scenarios, the classic 10-minute post-siren rule does NOT apply; users must wait for an explicit release message.
claims.source: ynet coverage of Pikud Ha'Oref app guidance and the dangerous confusion between the 10-minute rule and the ballistic-threat protocol.

claims.claim: Israeli Standard 4422 requires a minimum mamad floor area of 9 sq m, reinforced concrete walls/ceiling at least 25 cm thick with double rebar, ceiling height 2.5 to 2.8 m, and a 7-cm-thick steel blast door.
claims.source: Standards Institution of Israel (IS 4422 parts 1 and 2); architecture.org.il summary.

claims.claim: Per IS 4422 Amendment 4, the blast wall (קיר הדף) may be omitted if a special blast door is installed AND the mamad is at least 4 m from the building's external wall.
claims.source: Kolodny Law summary of IS 4422 amendments; top-migun.co.il standard summary.

claims.claim: Private mamad construction requests are submitted via Pikud Ha'Oref's licensing system at oref-rishuy.org.il; an architect, engineer, or building technician serves as orech bakasha; Pikud Ha'Oref responds within 14 days; post-construction certification is due within 45 days per Regulation 30(ד).
claims.source: Kol Zchut fast-track guide; Pikud Ha'Oref licensing portal.

claims.claim: Pikud Ha'Oref's emergency kit (ערכת חירום) recommendation includes water, non-perishable food, lighting/communication/spare batteries, first aid and personal medications, hygiene supplies, ID copies, cash; for families with children add formula, diapers, comfort items; for pet owners add a carrier and food.
claims.source: Pikud Ha'Oref preparing-protected-space article (oref.org.il); Hosen East Galilee emergency-kit checklist.

claims.claim: Pikud Ha'Oref recommends storing the emergency kit, water, and food permanently inside the mamad in a corner that does not block movement.
claims.source: Pikud Ha'Oref Facebook safety video on storing emergency supplies inside the mamad.

claims.claim: Galei Zahal broadcasts at 102.3 FM and Reshet Bet at 95.5 FM; both are recommended emergency frequencies.
claims.source: Skill's prior reference text, cross-checked against Israeli broadcasting frequencies in public listings. Treat as widely-published value, not authoritative.

claims.claim: Pikud Ha'Oref hotline: 1207 in Hebrew, 104 in English and other languages, available 24/7.
claims.source: Pikud Ha'Oref public-facing contact info; Modiin municipality and shivat-zion guidelines.

claims.claim: Pikud Ha'Oref guidance for being caught in a vehicle during a siren is to pull over, exit the vehicle, and enter a nearby building or stairwell. If no shelter is reachable, move away from the vehicle and lie face down. Tunnels are not formally endorsed as shelter.
claims.source: shivat-zion.com olim guidelines (Pikud Ha'Oref derivative); swiss-connection-israel siren guide.

claims.claim: RedAlert (redalert.me / Eladnava) has 3,000,000+ downloads, 4.7-star rating, and dedicated push notification servers; Tzofar / Tzeva Adom (tzevaadom.co.il) provides alerts via app, website, Chrome extension, Telegram, WhatsApp, X. Both are supplements to the official Pikud Ha'Oref app, not replacements.
claims.source: RedAlert official site; Tzofar/Tzeva Adom official site; IFCJ Stand For Israel comparison.

claims.claim: Mamad expansion option introduced in 2025 allows up to 12 sq m mamad + 3 sq m bathroom for new construction.
claims.source: Skill prior fact, consistent with Israeli planning and migun-il industry coverage of 2025 building-code amendment.

claims.claim: State Comptroller report (January 2026) audits municipal shelter readiness and finds significant gaps; public shelters should not be assumed open or maintained without verification.
claims.source: Mevaker HaMedina (State Comptroller of Israel) emergency report, January 2026.

claims.claim: Accessibility of public shelters is required under the Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities Law (Hok HaShivyon, 1998) and the 2005 accessibility regulations.
claims.source: Israeli civil-rights framework; commonly summarized in Pikud Ha'Oref and municipal guidance.

open_questions: Pikud Ha'Oref has not, in publicly available 2026 guidance, formally defined tunnel safety on highways. We instructed users to exit tunnels as soon as the road allows and find a protected building; if Pikud Ha'Oref publishes formal tunnel guidance in the future, update the Vehicle section.

Exact filter expiration dates for civilian NBC kits distributed during prior emergencies vary. We instruct users to check manufacturer schedules; an authoritative Pikud Ha'Oref civilian filter-lifecycle document would strengthen this section.
The fast-track private-mamad permit window relaxed under Iron Swords was originally set to expire in late October 2026. Re-verify on next update cycle whether the relaxation has been extended.
